lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ca6Ti2N6 (reduced formula Ca3TiN3) adopts the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194) and contains 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ca centers with 11 neighbors (2 Ca, 9 N) and Ti centers with 12 N neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement, while N centers have 10 neighbors (4 Ca, 6 Ti). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 11-vertex Ca polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Ca and Ti polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 14 sites.
